preconditions.description: Number of pastures is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of paths is between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, _ in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path connects distinct pastures within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 10**9 for _, _, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path has a length between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(line == -1 or any(sum(paved_paths[p] % 2 for p in range(1, n+1)) == 0 for paved_paths in all_paved_paths) for line, all_paved_paths in zip(output, all_possible_pavings))
postconditions.description: If a sunny paving exists, the output is the minimum possible length of the longest path; otherwise, it is -1.
